newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Alliance says would not recognise RSS "yes" vote.
newsitem.headline: Alliance says would not recognise RSS "yes" vote.

text.p: New Zealand opposition Alliance leader Jim Anderton said on Monday his party would not honour a referendum vote in favour of the government's compulsory superannuation scheme.
Anderton was speaking at a news conference to give the Alliance's reaction to the details of the Retirement Savings Scheme (RSS) presented by the government earlier on Monday.

Asked if it would recognise a "yes" result from the September referendum, he said "given that NZ$5.6 million will be spent on promotion of the new scheme, and none on the old, this will be a false referendum, falsely promoted, (so) the view of
It was not initially possible to confirm if the Alliance grouping was alone in taking this policy position.
